bios.minimum_scope: Lowest completed SeaBIOS/QEMU486 scaling workload:2MiB PASS,1MiB explicit NoSpace; full independent Windows gates additionally passed for486 and Pentium32MiB. Not a physical-hardware or Windows-installation RAM minimum.
bios.firmware_cpu_requirements: QEMU486 and Pentium complete the exact same i486-built workload at32MiB; application clock is BDA and entropy is host-CSPRNG fw_cfg PIO.

ia32.minimum_scope: Lowest completed supplied IA32 OVMF plus QEMU486 workload:43MiB PASS,42MiB exit35 failure.32MiB and40MiB timed out without an extracted application log; their precise failure point is unproven. Program allocator peak is separate from whole-firmware RAM.
ia32.firmware_cpu_requirements: The supplied IA32 OVMF completed on the tested QEMU486 model. The application is explicitly compiled i486 and generated assembly audited without SIMD/CMOV; physical486 firmware behavior is unverified.

x86_64.minimum_scope: Lowest completed supplied x64 OVMF plus QEMU qemu64 workload:52MiB PASS.48MiB and32MiB timed out without an extracted application log; their precise failure point is unproven.50MiB and51MiB were not run after the operator boundary stop, so no adjacent lower bound is claimed.
x86_64.firmware_cpu_requirements: QEMU qemu64 completed the workload; x86_64 application baseline includes SSE2. This does not establish the minimum of every physical x86_64 implementation.
